data.long_meaning: A woman who is thankful and appreciative. Derived from the Arabic root 'hmd', meaning to praise or be thankful.

This name can serve as an inspiration for women to cultivate a deep sense of gratitude and develop a positive attitude towards life.

It also serves as a reminder to be grateful for the simple things and to find joy and contentment in them. Furthermore, the name Hamdiyah can help foster a deep sense of gratitude for the ultimate blessing of being a creation of Allah and being able to worship Him.
